summary: AP mech bully who burns you with a short-range flamethrower and kites with harpoon slows. He manages a Heat bar: high Heat empowers his spells, but overheating silences him for a few seconds. Punish the overheat and stay out of flamethrower range.
threats: Q (Flamespitter) is a short-range cone that deals heavy damage over time; walk out of it.
Heat: past 50 Heat his spells are empowered; at 100 he overheats and can't cast for a few seconds.
E (Electro Harpoon) slows you; two harpoons stack the slow so he can kite and chase.
R (The Equalizer) at 5 lays down a burning line that slows. Don't fight inside it.

matchups.why: Jayce out-ranges Rumble's flamethrower with gated Shock Blast, so Rumble has to walk through poke to trade. Hammer E knocks Rumble away whenever he gets close enough to burn.
trading: Gated Cannon Q when he walks up to farm; it out-ranges his flamethrower.
Hammer E (Thundering Blow) him away when he closes in for Flamespitter.
Sidestep his harpoons so he can't stack the slow on you.
Trade hard when he overheats; he can't cast for a few seconds.
matchups.early: Poke from range at levels 1–3; he can't reach you without walking through Shock Blast.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R slows you if you stand in it. Poke from outside the burning line.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and take plates while he can't contest from range.
matchups.jungle: He's slow without his harpoon. Gank when he's overheated or out of position.
matchups.build: Electrocute or Phase Rush. Lethality items; MR boots.
matchups.remember: Poke from range, punish the overheat.

matchups.why: Mordekaiser's W (Indestructible) shield absorbs Rumble's burn, and his R isolates Rumble where his slows and kiting matter less. Mordekaiser wins any extended fight inside his Realm.
trading: Q (Obliterate) him when he walks up to farm.
W (Indestructible) to absorb his flamethrower damage.
E (Death's Grasp) pull him into your Q for burst.
Walk out of his flamethrower cone rather than trading inside it.
matchups.early: Trade with Q and shield; he out-damages you in long flamethrower trades early.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R takes him into a 1v1 where his kite is limited. Use it after he's used E.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and trade when the wave is with you; don't fight in his full wave.
matchups.jungle: He's slow without his harpoon. Gank when he's overheated.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Magic-pen bruiser items; MR boots.
matchups.remember: Shield the burn, realm the kite.

matchups.why: Rumble's damage is magic, so Malphite's armor doesn't help, but Malphite's Q poke and R give him kill pressure with a jungler. Neither can kill the other alone early, so the lane is decided by MR timing and ganks.
trading: Q (Seismic Shard) him when he walks up to farm, then walk away.
Walk out of his flamethrower cone rather than trading inside it.
Trade when he overheats; he can't cast for a few seconds.
Buy MR early; armor won't help here.
matchups.early: Farm safely and Q poke. Rush an MR item before taking any extended trades.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R plus your jungler kills him; his R slows your follow-up, so commit together.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and roam once your R is up; he can't follow quickly.
matchups.jungle: Your R sets up ganks. Call when he's overheated or out of position.
matchups.build: Grasp. MR boots and early MR items.

matchups.why: Rumble's harpoon slows let him kite Darius while his flamethrower burns, so Darius rarely gets the extended melee fight he needs. Darius has to land E pull to win any trade.
trading: E (Apprehend) pull him only when he's in range and his E is on cooldown.
Walk out of his flamethrower cone rather than trading inside it.
Trade hard when he overheats; he can't cast for a few seconds.
Don't chase him through his harpoon slows.
matchups.early: Farm safely and accept some burn; wait for him to overheat or waste E.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R slows you; your R execute needs him in range, so wait for him to commit.
matchups.wave: Let him push and farm under tower; don't walk into his flamethrower.
matchups.jungle: Ask for ganks; he's slow without his harpoon.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Ghost for chasing. MR boots.
